name: Harvst
tagline: The operating system for enterprise controlled-environment agriculture.
positioning: Harvst gives multi-site vertical farm operators unified control over climate, crop scheduling, and yield forecasting — priced by the growth cycle.

hero.h1: Run every grow room like your best grow room.
hero.sub: Harvst unifies climate control, crop scheduling, and yield forecasting across every rack and every facility — so your operations team manages hectares of vertical canopy from one console.

features.title: Live climate orchestration
features.description: Set recipes once and Harvst holds temperature, VPD, and CO₂ to spec across every zone — flagging drift before it costs you a harvest cycle.

features.title: Yield forecasting
features.description: Project harvest-ready weight per tray 21 days out, with confidence bands your buyers and CFO can actually plan against.

features.title: Crop scheduling engine
features.description: Sequence transplants, spacing, and harvest windows across facilities to keep every square meter of canopy producing revenue.

features.title: Compliance-ready records
features.description: Automatic audit trails for GAP, GlobalG.A.P., and retailer food-safety programs — export a full lot history in one click.

features.title: Multi-site rollups
features.description: Compare cost-per-kilogram, energy draw, and labor hours across regions in a single operations dashboard.

features.title: Hardware-agnostic control
features.description: Connect existing PLCs, sensors, and dosing systems over Modbus and BACnet — no rip-and-replace required.

testimonials.quote: Harvst cut our per-facility environmental incidents by 60% in the first quarter. My growers finally spend their time on agronomy instead of chasing sensor spreadsheets.
testimonials.name: Marisol Devereux

testimonials.quote: We onboarded four facilities in six weeks without swapping a single controller. The yield forecasts are now accurate enough that our retail contracts are built on them.
testimonials.name: Trevor Okafor

testimonials.quote: The lot-level audit trail turned our GlobalG.A.P. recertification from a two-week fire drill into an afternoon export.
testimonials.name: Anneke Vos
